claim_limits.statement: The construction is a repeatable abnormal-pressure representation, not a Fault 2 classifier
No claim is made about faults other than Fault 2

intake.data_source: Tennessee Eastman Process simulation data, Fault 2, simulation runs 1 to 10, as distributed in the Rieth et al. 2017 dataset; the reactor_pressure and time_(h) columns of each run, 3,001 rows per run.

measurements.description: Count of rising occurrences per run
measurements.name: rising_occurrences_count

measurements.description: Start time of each rising occurrence in hours
measurements.name: rising_occurrence_start_time

measurements.description: End time of each rising occurrence in hours
measurements.name: rising_occurrence_end_time

measurements.description: Duration of each rising occurrence in hours
measurements.name: rising_occurrence_duration

measurements.description: Pressure gained within each occurrence in kPa
measurements.name: rising_occurrence_pressure_gain

intake.object_definition: One row of the result is one rising occurrence of the smoothed reactor pressure: the interval from the first rising sample to the last, with the exit event on the last rising sample.

observation_schema.unit: hours since the start of the run
derived first difference of the envelope

preprocessing_steps.description: reactor_pressure_smooth is the rolling maximum of reactor_pressure over rolling_max_window rows, then the rolling mean over rolling_mean_window rows, shifted by offline_alignment_shift rows
reactor_pressure_change is the first difference of reactor_pressure_smooth
time_step_hours is the first difference of time_(h)
reactor_pressure_rate is reactor_pressure_change divided by time_step_hours
rows where any derived column is undefined are excluded and counted

intake.research_question: Does a reactor-pressure rate construction selected on one Fault 2 simulation run, and frozen, produce the same rising, falling and inactive partition on the other Fault 2 runs, and does it stay quiet on normal-operation windows?
intake.time_semantics: Each row is an instantaneous sample; the simulator records a row every three minutes.
intake.title: Tennessee Eastman reactor pressure states under Fault 2

validations.description: States are mutually exclusive and cover every valid observation
validations.name: states_mutually_exclusive_and_exhaustive

validations.description: Every run compiles to 3,001 observations with 99 excluded, 49 leading and 50 trailing
validations.name: run_observation_counts

validations.description: The partition on runs 1 to 9 matches the published construction row for row
validations.name: partition_match_published
